segments.text: One afternoon ago, the 12-year-old William was bored after repeatedly being corrected by his tutor, Miranda.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN FADES IN, REVEALING THE CHILDREN'S ROOM. WILLIAM'S SPRITE APPEARS WITH A NORMAL EXPRESSION]

segments.text: No, William. You should divide the number by three, not times them. Your calculation result will be three times bigger than the profit demands–
Ugh, why is everything I do always wrong? I'm tired of this…!

events.name: PlaySoundEffect
events.path: [<FOOTSTEPS APPROACHING, FOLLOWED BY A DOOR OPENING>]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM'S SPRITE FADES OUT]

segments.text: William?!

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN FADES TO BLACK]

segments.text: William walked out of the room without taking a single glance at his tutor. He proceeded to walk through the side corridors of the manor quietly, just not to get caught sneaking out by his mother.
Hmm… Ms. Miranda is always boring. What should I do now I'm out of her sight?

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [A FEW MOMENTS OF SILENCE PASS WHILE THE FOOTSTEPS CONTINUE]

segments.text: Oh! I haven’t played with Walter since this morning. That big doggo should be in the manor now. He’s usually hungry at this hour.

events.name: PlaySoundEffect
events.path: [<FOOTSTEPS QUICKENING INTO A RUN THROUGH THE CORRIDORS>]

segments.text: With Walter in mind, William starts to make his way through the corridors and down the stairs. There should be a place that his Irish Wolfhound would be going he knows by heart.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN FADES IN, REVEALING THE DINING ROOM AS THE DOOR OPENS]

segments.text: As usual, the dining room is empty since it’s not the time for lunch yet. But William knows that Walter often gets hungry fast, so he’s scheduled to get his meal at that hour.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [ARTHUR'S SPRITE APPEARS ON SCREEN, FOLLOWED BY THE SOUND OF PLATES BEING PLACED ON THE TABLE]

events.name: PlaySoundEffect
events.path: [<CERAMIC PLATES BEING ARRANGED ON THE DINING TABLE>]

segments.text: Instead, right there stands Arthur, the manor’s head butler, arranging the plates on the table to prepare for lunch.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM'S SPRITE APPEARS BESIDE ARTHUR'S SPRITE]

segments.text: Arthur, have you fed Walter this afternoon?
Upon hearing William’s question, Arthur turned his head to William for a moment before shifting his focus back on arranging the plates on the table as he answered calmly.
My apologies, young master, but it seems that Walter has not visited the dining room yet since I have been here waiting to feed him for a while.
Hmmm… That’s odd. He should feel hungry at this hour and very sluggish when he doesn't have his meals. Well, anyways, thank you, Arthur!

events.name: PlaySoundEffect
events.path: [<RUNNING FOOTSTEPS AND THE DINING ROOM DOOR OPENING>]

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM AND ARTHUR'S SPRITES FADE OUT AS WILLIAM RUNS OUT OF THE DINING ROOM]

segments.text: Without waiting for Arthur’s reply, William immediately bolts outside the dining room. A strange feeling settled in his gut about his dog’s whereabouts.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN TURNS DARK]

segments.text: Walter…! Walter?! Where are you??

William's voice echoes throughout the corridors he ran into, calling his beloved dog's name in hopes that the Irish Wolfhound will somehow respond to him. He decided to head into the entrance hall, hoping once again that he will catch the sight of Walter's happily wagging tail when the dog ran through the corridors.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN FADES IN, REVEALING THE MAIN ENTRANCE. MARGARET'S AND WILLIAM'S SPRITES APPEAR]

segments.text: Walter? Walter!
William, keep your tone down! Isn't this still the time in your schedule to study with Ms. Miranda?
Sorry, Mother, but have you seen Walter?
Walter? How could I know about that? Go back to studying and don't make Ms. Miranda wait for you!
He's not eating in the dining room, Mother!

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM'S SPRITE FADES OUT AS HE RUNS AWAY]

segments.text: William?!

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN FADES TO BLACK, AND MARGARET'S SPRITE FADES OUT]

segments.text: Even outside the manor, no matter how loudly William called his dog's name, there was still no sight of him anywhere. Ms. Miranda then caught up to him and dragged William back to the room for their study session while repeatedly reassuring him that Walter would be back soon, perhaps the furball was currently out exploring or taking a walk with one of the maids. That reassurance managed to drive William's focus back to his studies, so he decided to give his tutor of the day his best until the day ended.

The next day, William came back to studying with Ms. Miranda as usual. Though, in the back of his mind, he still thought of his Irish Wolfhound’s whereabouts. Until he eventually found out the truth four days later in the evening…

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN SHOWS THE DINING ROOM. ARTHUR'S SPRITE APPEARS]

segments.text: Madame, my apologies for interrupting your peaceful evening.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [MARGARET'S SPRITE FADES IN]

segments.text: Is there something you need, Arthur?
I received a report from a maid that there’s an unpleasant smell coming from the fuel storage room.
Have you checked it yet? If it’s from a dead mice then I question your servants’ competence in cleaning the manor.
I shall check the latter, then.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [ARTHUR AND MARGARET'S SPRITES FADE OUT, REPLACED BY NATHANIEL'S AND WILLIAM'S SPRITES]

segments.text: Sir Arthur, can I come with you?
I would like to tag along, Sir Arthur. Do you mind?

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM AND NATHANIEL'S SPRITES FADE OUT, REPLACED BY ARTHUR'S SPRITE]

segments.text: Very well. Please, follow me.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [ARTHUR'S SPRITE FADES OUT. THE BACKGROUND TURNS BLACK]

segments.text: William and Nathaniel then followed Arthur down to the basement with steady footsteps. As they all suspected, there was a heavy scent of rotten meat that sharply struck their senses, making all of them scrunch their noses from the intensity.
Stay here for a moment, young masters. I shall open and walk in first to check for possible danger.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [THE SCREEN FADES IN, REVEALING THE BASEMENT. THE LIGHT SWITCH CLICKS ON]

segments.text: The moment the lights turned on, right in the middle of the basement's cold ground, there lay Walter with some parts of his flesh starting to rot, the dog’s head lulled to the side with his lips turned pale blue. The Irish Wolfhound's tail no longer wagged, just lying there stiffly.

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM'S SPRITE APPEARS ON SCREEN]

segments.text: Walter…?

Without waiting for Arthur to back off, William immediately rushed to the dog’s side despite the horrible smell, sobbing loudly as he mourned the lifeless furball in front of him. It’s the first time he ever cried this hard for something ever in his whole life.
No… Walter!!

events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM'S SPRITE FADES OUT AND IS REPLACED BY NATHANIEL'S SPRITE WITH A HAPPY EXPRESSION]
